# Design variant categories

The original 20 report designs were grouped by layout architecture and visual language—not merely palette. One representative is retained per design type. Retained files use generic, reusable design names.

| Design type | Variants reviewed | Retained representative | Selection rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| Dark atmospheric product report | `01-midnight-glass`, `07-aurora-depth`, `10-ocean-ledger`, former `18-octo-dimmed` | **`18-dark-product.html`** | Keeps the strongest component hierarchy: product-style section bands, underline navigation, clear actions, and restrained atmospheric depth. |
| Editorial serif longform | `02-editorial-paper`, `08-magazine-ochre`, former `12-longform-folio` | **`12-longform-editorial.html`** | Replaces card-heavy styling with a true narrow essay measure, numbered sections, stat strip, and timeline. |
| Engineering/specification utility | `03-blueprint-grid`, `06-brutalist-caution`, former `19-framework-spec` | **`19-industrial-spec.html`** | Most practical professional implementation: modular hairline grid, specification tables, micro-labels, and functional accents. |
| Navigation-heavy documentation shell | `04-swiss-signal`, former `11-atlas-docs` | **`11-sidebar-docs.html`** | The fixed documentation rail is a clear and reusable application-shell pattern. |
| Soft rounded corporate report | `05-forest-calm`, `09-soft-clay`, former `20-blkb-petrol` | **`20-rounded-corporate.html`** | Retains calm rounded surfaces while improving hierarchy, trust, contrast, and professional restraint. |
| Marginal consulting brief | former `13-marginalia-brief` | **`13-marginal-layout.html`** | Unique two-column architecture with headings in a dedicated margin rail. |
| Dense operations console | former `14-ops-console` | **`14-compact-console.html`** | Unique high-density toolbar, wide canvas, compact data treatment, and two-column action board. |
| Graphic display poster | former `15-cobalt-poster` | **`15-graphic-poster.html`** | Unique near-viewport hero, oversized typography, ghost section numerals, and inverted figures. |
| Minimal content-first product page | former `16-codex-quiet` | **`16-minimal-landing.html`** | Unique centered hero, radical whitespace, flat sections, and highly restrained controls. |
| Plain-text README/terminal document | former `17-pi-readme` | **`17-terminal-readme.html`** | Unique monospace document language with Markdown markers, bracketed tabs, and dotted rules. |
